channel.title: Sketchbook Kitchen · recipes
channel.description: Illustrated cookbooks by BenizTor: recipes in grams, drawn in watercolor.

item.title: Baklava Yazdi (Almond Pistachio Baklava)
item.description: Layers of pastry and cardamom-spiced almonds and pistachios, soaked in saffron-rosewater syrup. Lighter and less sweet than its Turkish cousin. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Sticky Toffee Pudding
item.description: Soft date sponge drowned in toffee sauce. The British pudding that ends every winter feast. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Mint Chocolate
item.description: Cool peppermint buttercream, tinted the palest green, on a dark chocolate cake. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Brown Butter Toffee Pecan
item.description: Brown butter, dark sugar, toffee bits and toasted pecans. Deep caramel in every bite, finished with a pinch of salt. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Keyk-e Yazdi (Yazdi Cupcakes)
item.description: Little yogurt cakes scented with cardamom and rosewater, from the desert city of Yazd. Soft, fragrant and unfrosted. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Whole Clementine Almond Cake
item.description: Boiled whole clementines blended into a moist, flourless almond cake. Naturally gluten-free and even better the next day. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter
item.description: Rich chocolate cake under a fluffy peanut butter frosting. Salty, sweet and impossible to eat just one. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: White Chocolate Cranberry
item.description: Tart cranberries, sweet white chocolate and a little orange zest. This one tastes like the holidays. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Roulette (Persian Cream Roll)
item.description: A soft sponge rolled around whipped cream and strawberries, sliced to show the spiral. A tea-party classic. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Cranberry Orange Loaf
item.description: A tender orange loaf studded with tart cranberries and finished with a sharp orange glaze. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Salted Caramel Chocolate
item.description: Chocolate cake with a spoonful of caramel hidden inside and a caramel buttercream on top. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Triple Chocolate Fudge
item.description: Half brownie, half cookie: shiny, crackled tops and a fudgy middle, studded with milk and white chocolate. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Nan-e Khamei (Persian Cream Puffs)
item.description: Small choux puffs filled with vanilla cream and dusted with sugar. The star of every Iranian birthday and party. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Eggnog Bundt Cake
item.description: Nutmeg-scented butter cake made with eggnog, with an eggnog glaze dripping down the ridges. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Mocha
item.description: Coffee in the cake and espresso in the buttercream. For anyone who takes dessert with a double shot. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Hazelnut-Stuffed Cocoa
item.description: A dark cocoa cookie with a molten hazelnut spread centre. Freezing the filling first is what keeps it inside. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Zaban (Puff Pastry Tongues)
item.description: Flaky tongue-shaped puff pastries from Qazvin, brushed with honey and rosewater and sprinkled with pistachio. A nostalgic Nowruz favourite. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Bûche de Noël
item.description: A light chocolate sponge rolled around vanilla mascarpone cream and covered in ganache bark. The French Christmas log. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Double Chocolate Ganache
item.description: Chocolate cake with melting chips inside, dipped in a glossy dark ganache. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Giant Walnut Chocolate Chunk
item.description: Tall, craggy and gooey in the middle. Cold butter, a hot oven and heavy dough balls are what keep these cookies thick. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Koloocheh (Fuman Walnut Cookies)
item.description: Stamped round cookies from the town of Fuman in Gilan, filled with cinnamon and walnut. Travellers on the road north stop for them warm. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Chocolate Peppermint Sandwiches
item.description: Dark chocolate cookies with a cool peppermint cream and crushed candy canes rolled around the edge. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Marble
item.description: Swirls of vanilla and chocolate batter in every cupcake, so no two look alike. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Chewy Molasses Spice
item.description: Dark, chewy and crackled, with ginger, cinnamon and a hint of clove. Coarse sugar on the outside gives each one a sparkle and a crunch. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Nan-e Kermanshahi (Kermanshah Butter Cookies)
item.description: Rich, golden butter cookies from western Iran, traditionally made with the region's famous ghee, finished with sesame. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.
